MINIMAL COST (theorem, not a search over IDCM numbers): a finite group has a genuinely complex irreducible character iff some element is NOT conjugate to its inverse; every group of order <= 2 (=1 or Z2) has all characters real, so the minimal finite carrier of a genuinely complex phase is Z3 (order 3, character omega = exp(2 pi i/3)). For a CONTINUOUS U(1) phase one needs a non-discrete sector. 2I satisfies neither: it is perfect (A4) with all-real characters (A3)
